description: Adds photos to one of your seller products, from public https links to PNG or JPG images (up to 10 MB each) or from images the user attached, where the app passes attached files to tools. New photos go after the ones already on the listing; none is removed or reordered. A listing holds 6 photos. Only seller products from list_my_listings. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

listing_id.description: A seller product id from list_my_listings (prd_...)

photo_files.description: Images the user attached, as the file objects an app passes to tools. Leave out when you have no download_url for an image

photo_urls.description: Public https links, each downloading one PNG or JPG image (a direct link to the file, not a web page)

name: add_listing_photos
title: Add photos to a listing
